name: Chow Kon Yeow
_note: M2 state-executive cohort (Phase 2). Chief Minister of Penang since 2018 (second and final term from Aug 2023). Added as a PH-aligned rich-state executive to balance the class. Provisional Layer B anchors pending the blind panel (minCodersToScore=3). Citations search-corroborated; reconfirm against primary sources. A5 none-on-record: he was questioned (not charged) in the undersea-tunnel matter; the charges there belong to his predecessor (a separate person) and a 2026 zakat probe concerns his deputy, not him.

metrics.justification: Chow has never been charged; he gave a statement to MACC over the undersea-tunnel project in 2020 as a person assisting the investigation, not a suspect, and the corruption charges in that saga belong to his predecessor, a separate individual. A 2026 zakat-fund probe concerns his deputy, not him. Recorded as the subject's own status: none on record.

Facing repeated flash-flooding through 2024, his administration ran a preparedness-led response: 53 flood hotspots identified, hundreds of evacuation centres readied, a disaster command centre, and about RM1 billion in flood-mitigation works with the drainage department, while he publicly acknowledged that mitigation reduces but cannot prevent floods. Documented, preparedness-led response (anchor 3).

citation.title: Penang on alert for potential floods, says chief minister

metrics.justification: The long-stalled Penang LRT Mutiara Line held its groundbreaking on 11 Jan 2025 with construction underway by mid-2025; the linked Penang South reclamation was delivered but materially scaled down, reduced about 49% to a single island at federal request. A flagship delivered after long delay, with the reclamation diluted (anchor 3).

citation.title: Mutiara LRT Line to span 29.5km with 21 stations linking Penang's key hubs

metrics.justification: He personally tabled the 2018 amendment to the Penang State Constitution capping the Chief Minister at two terms, a self-limit Penang says was a national first, and in May 2026 reaffirmed he would not amend or extend it to seek a third term. A durable institutional check imposed on his own office (anchor 4).

citation.title: Penang passes two-term limit for chief minister

metrics.justification: On 20 Sep 2024 he stated flatly there was no state policy to give cash aid to flood victims; within days state and federal assistance was arranged for affected Prai-district households, so the firm position softened under pressure without a clearly owned reversal. Reversed without an explicit on-record acknowledgement (anchor 2).

citation.title: No cash aid for flood victims from state, says CM Chow

metrics.justification: His documented conduct leans to de-escalation: in August 2023 he urged voters to reject parties that play up racial and religious issues, and in September 2024 his administration opened a Street of Harmony in Bayan Baru clustering six houses of worship, with plans to extend the model. Dated affirmative restraint, no adverse 3R event on record (anchor 2).

citation.title: Penang to establish more 'Streets of Harmony' to promote unity
